info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Support Tickets Update-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and update their support tickets. This endpoint allows authorized users to replace existing ticket information with new data, ensuring that the support team's records are accurate and up-to-date. Common consumers of this API include customer support agents and automated systems that handle ticketing workflows. By streamlining ticket updates, organizations can improve customer satisfaction and response times.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of an existing ticket. Ensure to provide the necessary ticket ID and the updated information in the request body to successfully modify the ticket details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update ticket information. Please ensure that all required fields are provided in the correct format to successfully update the ticket details.

ReplaceSupportTicketsUpdateRequest.title: Ticket Update Request Body

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

customer.description: The customer information associated with the ticket.

resource.description: The resource associated with the ticket.

priority.description: The priority level of the ticket.

amount.description: The monetary amount associated with the ticket.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if notification is required for the ticket.

requestedAt.description: The date and time when the request was made.

channel.description: The channel through which the request is made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record in the ticketing system.

ReplaceSupportTicketsUpdateRequest.description: The request body for updating a ticket, including customer details and ticket information.

Customer.title: Customer Information

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates if the customer is a VIP.

Customer.description: Detailed information about the customer associated with the ticket.

ReplaceSupportTicketsUpdateResponse_201.title: Update Ticket Response

status.description: Indicates whether the update operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result from the update operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after the update.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the update request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the update response.

ReplaceSupportTicketsUpdateResponse_201.description: This schema represents the response returned when a ticket is successfully updated.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created, in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket was created through an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains information about the audit details related to the ticket update.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A lower value indicates a more efficient request handling.
